tickets.title: Organize estate planning file
tickets.text: Organize a planning-side file separating probate assets, beneficiary assets, estate professionals, family decision points, and household planning impacts for Lydia Cloudpuddle.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to organize that file by 2025-08-08.

tickets.title: Address inherited IRA claim packet
tickets.text: Address the claim‑packet requirements for the inherited IRA at Velvet Acorn Custody, including obtaining a certified death certificate, letters of authority, and completing the beneficiary claim packet for Lydia Cloudpuddle.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to address the claim-packet requirements by 2025-08-01.

tickets.title: Resolve Tin Sparrow account ownership
tickets.text: Resolve the ownership treatment of the Tin Sparrow Investments brokerage account, reconciling the transfer‑on‑death registration with the probate asset listing for Lydia Cloudpuddle.
tickets.evidence: The ownership treatment remains unresolved before estate accounting can be finalized, with follow-up needed by 2025-08-15.

tickets.title: Prepare estate cash‑flow calendar
tickets.text: Prepare a practical calendar showing recurring condominium expenses, sale‑preparation costs, estate‑paid items, and any personal advances by co‑executors for Lydia Cloudpuddle.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to prepare that calendar by 2025-08-06.

tickets.title: Complete inherited IRA distribution review
tickets.text: Complete a planning review of available inherited IRA distribution approaches, taxable income effects, withholding preferences, and withdrawal pacing for Lydia Cloudpuddle.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to complete that review by 2025-09-05.

tickets.title: Align contingent beneficiary designations
tickets.text: Address the alignment of contingent beneficiary designations so that both Mara and Theo Cloudpuddle are equally named across Lydia Cloudpuddle’s retirement assets.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to address the beneficiary alignment by 2025-08-22.

tickets.title: Obtain estate professional communication authorization
tickets.text: Obtain written authorization allowing Sienna Bramblequill of Paper Otter Legal to discuss asset values, beneficiary registrations, basis information, and liquidity questions with Apricot Compass Advisory and Clockwork Clover Tax for Lydia Cloudpuddle.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to obtain the authorization by 2025-07-30.

tickets.title: Correct Velvet Acorn account name
tickets.text: Address the name correction for the Velvet Acorn Custody inherited account, updating the record from Lydia Velvetreed to Lydia Cloudpuddle.
tickets.evidence: The mismatch may prevent acceptance of inherited account paperwork unless the custodian corrects the registration workflow, and the agreed follow-up is to address the name correction by 2025-08-04.
